preconditions.description: T is a positive integer representing the number of test cases, bounded by 1 to 30.

preconditions.expression: all(N.is_integer() and N >= 2 and N <= 1000 for N in [int(line.strip()) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if line.strip()])
preconditions.description: Each N is an integer between 2 and 1000, inclusive, representing the size of the permutation to construct.

postconditions.expression: all(len(set(permutation)) == N and set(permutation) == set(range(1, N + 1)) for permutation in [list(map(int, line.strip().split())) for line in stdout.splitlines()])
postconditions.description: Each output permutation is a valid permutation of the set {1, 2, ..., N} for the corresponding N.

postconditions.expression: all(len(permutation) == N for permutation in [list(map(int, line.strip().split())) for line in stdout.splitlines()])
postconditions.description: Each output permutation has exactly N elements.

postconditions.expression: all(permutation == sorted(permutation) or permutation != sorted(permutation) for permutation in [list(map(int, line.strip().split())) for line in stdout.splitlines()])
postconditions.description: Each permutation is not necessarily sorted, allowing for any valid arrangement.

postconditions.expression: all(not any(median(prefix_i) == median(prefix_j) for i in range(1, N) for j in range(i + 1, N + 1) if j - i == 1) for permutation in [list(map(int, line.strip().split())) for line in stdout.splitlines()])
postconditions.description: For each permutation, no two adjacent prefixes (of lengths i and i+1) have the same median, where median is defined as the middle element of the sorted prefix.
